_comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - not a recording of any site.
Reproduces the shape of GET /v1/comics/{id}: meta.code plus a payload.results
object carrying the series' own fields and a nested 'artist' object whose
roman_name is the display form of the slug-ish 'name'.
Why synthetic: see search.json. Every value here is invented; the shape is a
fact observed live against the real API on 2026-09-21/22.
Deliberate variation: status_name is 'Hiatus', mixed case, exercising the
case-insensitive status() mapping rather than the more common 'Ongoing'.

results.name: The Lighthouse Keeper's Almanac
results.description: A keeper of a remote lighthouse records what the tide brings in.
